title: theopsis fluviatilis
intro: Theopsis fluviatilis, commonly known as the river tickseed, is a flowering plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in reducing fever and treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of Theopsis fluviatilis include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and a diuretic, providing relief from muscle spasms and promoting urine production. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
